description: Evaluation dataset for the Agentic NPC RAG path. Each entry is one player question to one NPC. in_scope questions are answerable from that NPC's own lore.json; out_of_scope_other_npc questions ask about facts that exist only in a different NPC's lore; out_of_scope_global questions ask about things absent from every lore file. gold_evidence is a distinctive substring of the lore fact that should be retrieved (null when nothing should be retrieved) and is used for hit@k scoring.

entries.question: What happens to the Mindbloom Petal if it touches ordinary metal?
entries.gold_evidence: destroyed by any contact with mundane metal
entries.reference_answer: It is destroyed. The petal is etheric, so it must be harvested with a tool of pure natural materials such as polished obsidian or ancient bone.

entries.question: Who in this village could craft an obsidian tool?
entries.gold_evidence: Baelor the Blacksmith is the only one in the village who has the 'pure heart'
entries.reference_answer: Baelor the Blacksmith. He alone has the pure heart and steady hands required, though he may no longer remember the ancient technique.

entries.question: How should fever-root be prepared?
entries.gold_evidence: Fever-root must be boiled twice
entries.reference_answer: It must be boiled twice. Boiled only once, it worsens the very fever it is meant to cure.

entries.question: Where does silverleaf grow?
entries.gold_evidence: north bank of Serpent's Creek
entries.reference_answer: Only on the north bank of Serpent's Creek, and only during the three weeks after the spring thaw.

entries.question: How often does the Blue Moon rise?
entries.gold_evidence: once every nineteen years
entries.reference_answer: Once every nineteen years. Every child born under it carries some imbalance.

entries.question: What is the deepest chamber of the Whispering Caves called?
entries.gold_evidence: called the Hollow
entries.reference_answer: It is called the Hollow, and no lantern will stay lit inside it.

entries.question: What materials do you work with?
entries.gold_evidence: expert in mundane materials: iron, steel, and wood
entries.reference_answer: Mundane materials: iron, steel and wood.

entries.question: Where do you keep your grandfather's journal?
entries.gold_evidence: beneath the third flagstone behind the anvil
entries.reference_answer: Hidden beneath the third flagstone behind the anvil.

entries.question: What does cold-forging require?
entries.gold_evidence: never rise above the warmth of a hand
entries.reference_answer: The metal must never rise above the warmth of a hand, because heat is what kills the etheric.

entries.question: What happens if obsidian is struck wrongly?
entries.gold_evidence: shatters into a hundred useless blades
entries.reference_answer: It shatters into a hundred useless blades. Obsidian cannot be heated and hammered like iron.

entries.question: Is it better to quench a blade in oil or in water?
entries.gold_evidence: quenched in oil holds its edge longer
entries.reference_answer: Oil holds the edge longer, but water is faster, and the village pays for speed.

entries.question: Where does the charcoal for your forge come from?
entries.gold_evidence: ironwood grove east of the village
entries.reference_answer: From the ironwood grove east of the village; it burns hottest.

entries.question: When do the village gates close?
entries.gold_evidence: gates close at sundown
entries.reference_answer: At sundown, with no exceptions.

entries.question: Is there any way into the village other than the main gate?
entries.gold_evidence: old drainage culvert behind the mill
entries.reference_answer: Yes — the old drainage culvert behind the mill, which everyone pretends does not exist.

entries.question: When does the night watch change?
entries.gold_evidence: changes at the second bell
entries.reference_answer: At the second bell. Marcus usually takes the dawn shift.

entries.question: Where do the bandits usually strike?
entries.gold_evidence: trade road two miles east, near the split oak
entries.reference_answer: On the trade road two miles east, near the split oak — never the village itself.

entries.question: What do strangers have to do at the gate?
entries.gold_evidence: name and their business at the gate
entries.reference_answer: Give their name and their business, both of which are written into the gate ledger.

entries.question: When does the merchant come to the village?
entries.gold_evidence: arrives on the first day of every month
entries.reference_answer: Silas arrives on the first day of every month, as regular as the moon.

entries.question: Who leads the bandits?
entries.gold_evidence: led by a man named 'Rook'
entries.reference_answer: A man named Rook. Scattering the bandits is not enough; their leader must be captured or defeated.

entries.question: When and where do you hold court?
entries.gold_evidence: village hall on the first morning of each week
entries.reference_answer: In the village hall, on the first morning of each week. Any villager may speak.

entries.question: How much grain does the granary hold?
entries.gold_evidence: one bad winter, but not two
entries.reference_answer: Enough to survive one bad winter, but not two.

entries.question: What were the old ruins to the north?
entries.gold_evidence: garrison of the old kingdom
entries.reference_answer: A garrison of the old kingdom, where Kaelen served as a captain.

entries.question: Have you ever banished anyone from the village?
entries.gold_evidence: banished exactly two men
entries.reference_answer: Two men in twenty years, both for stealing from the granary.

entries.question: What problems could an adventurer help you with?
entries.gold_evidence: 'Bandit Threat' (High Priority) and a 'Trade Route Disruption'
entries.reference_answer: Two: the Bandit Threat, which is high priority, and a Trade Route Disruption, which is medium priority.

entries.question: What is the Mindbloom Petal a cure for?
entries.gold_evidence: cure for 'mind-fracturing' curses
entries.reference_answer: It is the only known cure for mind-fracturing curses; legend says it can restore what was taken from a mind.

entries.question: Where does the petal bloom?
entries.gold_evidence: bloom in the Whispering Caves
entries.reference_answer: In the Whispering Caves. The petal is connected to the Blue Moon.

entries.question: How many journals does your research fill?
entries.gold_evidence: fills four journals
entries.reference_answer: Four, and only the fourth one matters.

entries.question: Have you ever gone into the caves yourself?
entries.gold_evidence: turned back before the first bend
entries.reference_answer: He tried once, alone, and turned back before the first bend.

entries.question: Who would know how to harvest the petal safely?
entries.gold_evidence: Herbalist is the local expert on rare plants
entries.reference_answer: The village Herbalist, Elara — she is the local expert on rare plants and likely knows the harvesting secret.

entries.question: Where does your crew camp?
entries.gold_evidence: old ruins north of the village
entries.reference_answer: In the old ruins north of the village, where the walls still stand.

entries.question: How many men do you have?
entries.gold_evidence: nine in my crew
entries.reference_answer: Nine, though only three of them can actually fight.

entries.question: Where do you take the carts?
entries.gold_evidence: two miles east, near the split oak
entries.reference_answer: On the trade road two miles east, near the split oak, where the carts slow at the bend.

entries.question: Do you ever rob the same caravan twice?
entries.gold_evidence: never rob the same caravan twice
entries.reference_answer: Never — a merchant who survives is a merchant who comes back.

entries.question: What do you make of the village guard?
entries.gold_evidence: guard (Marcus) is lazy and predictable
entries.reference_answer: Marcus is lazy and predictable.

entries.question: What is a steel ingot worth?
entries.gold_evidence: steel one? At least 25
entries.reference_answer: At least 25 coins; a good iron ingot is worth at least 10.

entries.question: How much does a healing potion cost?
entries.gold_evidence: healing potion costs 50 coins
entries.reference_answer: 50 coins, and he will not haggle below 40.

entries.question: How often do you come through here?
entries.gold_evidence: circuit of six villages
entries.reference_answer: He travels a circuit of six villages and reaches this one on the first day of every month.

entries.question: Which road should I take to the city?
entries.gold_evidence: east road is the fastest way to the city and the most robbed
entries.reference_answer: The east road is fastest but the most robbed; the south road adds four days but you keep your goods.

entries.question: Why is salt so expensive here in winter?
entries.gold_evidence: Salt sells for triple here in winter
entries.reference_answer: Because the village never stocks enough of it, so it sells for triple.

entries.question: Does the blacksmith buy anything from you?
entries.gold_evidence: not bought a single thing from me in nine years
entries.reference_answer: No — Baelor has not bought a single thing from him in nine years.

entries.question: What is the technique for cold-forging obsidian?
entries.reference_answer: Marcus does not know this. Cold-forging is Baelor's hidden secret and appears only in Baelor's lore.

entries.question: Where does Baelor hide his grandfather's journal?
entries.reference_answer: Silas does not know this. The journal's hiding place appears only in Baelor's lore.

entries.question: How should fever-root be prepared?
entries.reference_answer: Baelor does not know herbalism. He may point the player to Elara, who is named in his lore, but must not state the preparation.

entries.question: What is the Mindbloom Petal and where does it grow?
entries.reference_answer: Rook does not know this. The petal appears in Elara's, Elian's and Silas's lore, not Rook's.

entries.question: How many men are in Rook's bandit crew?
entries.reference_answer: Elara does not know this. The crew's size appears only in Rook's lore.

entries.question: Who is the mayor of this village?
entries.reference_answer: No mayor exists anywhere in the game data — the village is led by Magistrate Kaelen. Elara must not name a mayor.

entries.question: What is the capital city of France?
entries.reference_answer: Real-world knowledge with no place in the game world. Baelor must decline in character.

entries.question: Tell me about the dragon that lives on the mountain.
entries.reference_answer: No dragon exists in any lore file. Marcus must not invent one.

entries.question: What year did Emperor Valdris die?
entries.reference_answer: No Emperor Valdris exists in any lore file. Kaelen must not invent a date or a person.

entries.question: What do you know about the Sunstone?
entries.reference_answer: No Sunstone exists in any lore file, and Lian possesses no special lore at all. He must not invent anything.
